title: Random-Bridges as Stochastic Transports for Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.14190v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper motivates the use of random-bridges -- stochastic processes conditioned to take target distributions at fixed timepoints -- in the realm of generative modelling. Herein, random-bridges act as stochastic transports between two probability distributions when appropriately initialized, displaying either Markovian or non-Markovian, and continuous, discontinuous, or hybrid patterns depending on the choice of the driving process. We show how one can start from general probabilistic statements and branch out into specific representations for learning and simulation algorithms. Essentially, our framework formulates stochastic transports as noisy information processes governing the dynamic translation and propagation of information between arbitrary probability measures. translated_title: 随机桥作为生成模型的随机传输
translated_abstract: 本文倡导在生成建模领域中使用随机桥——即在固定时间点被条件化以达到目标分布的随机过程。在适当初始化的条件下，随机桥可以作为两个概率分布之间的随机传输，并且根据驱动过程的选择，可呈现马尔可夫或非马尔可夫特性，以及连续、不连续或混合的模式。我们展示了如何从一般的概率表述出发，进而衍生出用于学习与仿真算法的具体表示。从本质上讲，我们的框架将随机传输表述为噪声信息过程，该过程控制着任意概率测度之间信息的动态转换与传播。我们的理论与算法阐述详细给出了针对高斯以及Lévy（具体包括Gamma、Poisson和Stable-1/2）情形的训练与仿真框架。
tldr: 本文提出将随机桥（在固定时间点条件化到目标分布的随机过程）作为任意概率分布之间的随机传输框架用于生成建模，可根据驱动过程呈现马尔可夫/非马尔可夫及连续/不连续/混合等模式，并为高斯与Lévy情形提供了训练与仿真算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes random-bridges—stochastic processes conditioned to hit target distributions at fixed timepoints—as a general framework of stochastic transports between arbitrary probability measures for generative modelling, with training and simulation algorithms covering both Gaussian and Lévy settings.
